title: We now know who the Newberry Wolves are playing this season of college football - Upper West SC News
text:
The Newberry Wolves now know who they’ll face on the gridiron in the 2025 college football season.
The Wolves kick off the season away against the UVA Wise Cavaliers on Sept. 6 at Carl Smith Stadium.
The Wolves end their season at home against the Carson-Newman Eagles on Nov. 8 at Setzler Field.
They play a total of 10 games this year in the regular season with 6 of those games at home and 4 away or at neutral sites.
Some games may change due to unforeseen mid-season circumstances.
Date | Time | Opponent | Venue |
---|---|---|---|
Sept. 6 | 6 p.m. | UVA Wise Cavaliers | Carl Smith Stadium |
Sept. 13 | 7 p.m. | Point Skyhawks | Setzler Field |
Sept. 20 | 7 p.m. | Catawba Indians | Setzler Field |
Sept. 27 | 6 p.m. | Lenoir-Rhyne Bears | Helen & Leonard Moretz Stadium |
Oct. 4 | 7 p.m. | Wingate Bulldogs | Setzler Field |
Oct. 11 | 2 p.m. | Tusculum Pioneers | Pioneer Field |
Oct. 18 | 6 p.m. | Mars Hill Mountain Lions | Setzler Field |
Oct. 25 | 6 p.m. | Emory & Henry Wasps | Setzler Field |
Nov. 1 | 4 p.m. | Anderson Trojans | Melvin & Dollie Younts Stadium |
Nov. 8 | 1 p.m. | Carson-Newman Eagles | Setzler Field |
